context: Tests whether the agent forward-ports a library slice across a format boundary (ubuntu-24.04 v1 -> ubuntu-26.04 v3). Every check inspects the artefacts: chisel-releases/slices/libestr0.yaml, chisel-releases/tests/spread/integration/libestr0/task.yaml, and git log in chisel-releases/.

checklist.name: Map-form essential (file-level)
checklist.description: In chisel-releases/slices/libestr0.yaml, the file-level essential: block uses map syntax (e.g. 'libestr0_copyright:') not list syntax (e.g. '- libestr0_copyright')

checklist.name: Map-form essential (slice-level)
checklist.description: In chisel-releases/slices/libestr0.yaml, every per-slice essential: block uses map syntax (e.g. 'libc6_libs:') not list syntax (e.g. '- libc6_libs')

checklist.name: Slice structure preserved
checklist.description: chisel-releases/slices/libestr0.yaml contains exactly the same slice names as the source (libs and copyright), with no added or removed slices

checklist.name: Copyright slice last
checklist.description: In chisel-releases/slices/libestr0.yaml, the copyright slice appears after all other slices (it is the last entry under slices:)

checklist.name: Test exercises the libs slice
checklist.description: chisel-releases/tests/spread/integration/libestr0/task.yaml contains a reference to libestr0_libs (installing or checking that slice)

checklist.name: Test proves the library is real
checklist.description: chisel-releases/tests/spread/integration/libestr0/task.yaml checks that libestr.so.0 is a valid ELF object (magic bytes, 'file', or 'readelf -h'), or loads it, rather than only 'test -f' as the 24.04 source test did

checklist.name: First commit subject format
checklist.description: git log in chisel-releases/ shows a commit whose subject starts with 'feat(libestr0):' (lowercase, colon, space)

checklist.name: Second commit subject format
checklist.description: git log in chisel-releases/ shows a separate commit whose subject starts with 'test(libestr0):' (lowercase, colon, space)

checklist.name: Commit body explains the boundary
checklist.description: The body of the feat(libestr0): commit in chisel-releases/ mentions the essential: syntax change from list (v1) to map (v3) as the adaptation made for the target format

checklist.name: No PR opened
checklist.description: No pull request was opened: no PR URL and no 'gh pr create' evidence anywhere in the working directory
